route.objective: Reconcile the IAM onboarding baseline against security decision SD-77 and related notes, perform structured requirements analysis on the approved external auditor access requirement to identify semantic ambiguities, and assess the change impact of introducing the auditor capability while deferring downstream decomposition, acceptance criteria, and test derivation.

not_selected.reason: Explicitly deferred by user instruction and blocked pending resolution of material semantic unknowns and decision boundaries.
Explicitly excluded until requirements analysis resolves missing approval authority, SLA start triggers, duration limits, and identity provisioning paths.
Executable test coverage cannot be derived prior to resolving material requirement ambiguities and elaborating acceptance criteria.

stop_rules: Do not proceed to decomposition, acceptance criteria elaboration, or test case derivation until material unknowns (SLA start trigger, duration limits, approval authority, identity source, renewal policy, privileged access eligibility) are formally decided.
Preserve baseline requirements IAM-10, IAM-11, IAM-12, and IAM-13 as confirmed unchanged; the 30-day expiration suggestion in meeting notes is unapproved and must remain blocked/deferred.
Do not assign approval authority to the audit programme manager without explicit source authority; record decision ownership as Unknown.
Do not invent default durations, technical provisioning mechanisms, or approval workflows.
route.expected_final_artifact: A traceable change reconciliation register capturing SD-77 as an added requirement alongside unchanged baseline items, a structured requirements analysis exposing all unresolved semantics and missing decisions for external auditor access, and a targeted change-impact assessment evaluating the operational, system, and stakeholder impacts of the new actor and SLA.
